en.name: Vegetables
en.subtitle: Leafy greens, roots and everyday vegetables — how to choose and store them.

zh.name: 蔬菜
zh.subtitle: 葉菜、根莖與日常蔬菜——挑選與保存要訣。

en.name: Leafy greens
en.desc: Bok choy, spinach, A-choy and the like — quick-cooking and perishable. Stir-fry, blanch, or drop into soup.
en.tip: Wrap in dry paper towel and bag loosely; don't wash until you cook.

zh.name: 葉菜類
zh.desc: 小白菜、菠菜、A 菜之類——易熟也易壞。快炒、汆燙或入湯皆宜。
zh.tip: 用乾紙巾包起鬆裝入袋，烹煮前再清洗。

en.name: Cabbage
en.desc: Sweet, crunchy and versatile — Taiwan's everyday cabbage. Stir-fry, braise, or shred raw.
en.tip: Keep whole and unwashed in the crisper; wrap cut faces in plastic and use within days.

zh.name: 高麗菜
zh.desc: 清甜爽脆、用途廣，是台灣的日常高麗菜。快炒、滷煮或生切涼拌皆可。
zh.tip: 整顆不清洗放蔬果室；切開後切面包好，數日內食用。

en.name: Daikon radish
en.desc: Large white winter radish, mild and juicy. Simmers into soups and braises, or pickles crisp.
en.tip: Cut off the leafy tops, peel completely, cut into chunks and seal in a bag with the air pressed out — keeps about a month in the crisper. Don't freeze whole (it turns mushy); grated is fine.

zh.name: 白蘿蔔
zh.desc: 冬季大型白蘿蔔，清甜多汁。燉湯、滷煮，或醃漬成爽脆小菜。
zh.tip: 切除葉子、削去外皮、切段後裝入夾鏈袋擠出空氣，放蔬果室冷藏可存約一個月。整條勿冷凍（易軟爛），磨成泥則可。

en.name: Carrot
en.desc: Sweet orange root, good raw or cooked. Adds color and sweetness to stir-fries, soups and stews.
en.tip: Remove the green tops, bag in the crisper; keep away from apples and other ethylene fruit.

zh.name: 紅蘿蔔
zh.desc: 橙色甜味根菜，生熟皆宜。為快炒、湯品與燉菜增色添甜。
zh.tip: 去掉綠葉後裝袋放蔬果室；遠離蘋果等會釋放乙烯的水果。

en.name: Potato
en.desc: A starchy all-rounder. Boil, mash, fry or stew — it soaks up flavor and turns creamy.
en.tip: Cool, dark and out of sunlight in a paper bag with an apple keeps them 1–3 months (the apple slows sprouting); in humid weather, a perforated bag in the fridge lasts 1–2 weeks. Toss any that turn green or sprout.

zh.name: 馬鈴薯
zh.desc: 百搭的澱粉根莖。水煮、搗泥、油炸或燉煮皆宜，易吸味、口感綿密。
zh.tip: 陰涼避光、裝紙袋並放顆蘋果，可存 1～3 個月（蘋果延緩發芽）；潮濕時改用打孔袋冷藏約 1～2 週。變綠或發芽的請丟棄。

en.name: Sweet potato
en.desc: Sweet, dense root with orange or yellow flesh. Steam, bake or fry; the leaves are eaten too.
en.tip: Cool, dark and airy; never refrigerate — cold turns them hard and off-flavored.

zh.name: 地瓜
zh.desc: 香甜紮實的根莖，橙肉或黃肉。蒸、烤或炸皆宜；地瓜葉也可食用。
zh.tip: 陰涼、避光、通風；切勿冷藏，低溫會使其變硬走味。

en.name: Shiitake mushroom
en.desc: Meaty, savory mushrooms, fresh or dried. Fresh ones sauté and stew; dried ones rehydrate into a deeper, umami stock.
en.tip: Keep in a paper bag, not plastic, to avoid sogginess.

zh.name: 香菇
zh.desc: 肉厚味鮮，有鮮品與乾貨。鮮香菇煎炒、燉煮；乾香菇泡發後香氣更濃，可入高湯。
zh.tip: 以紙袋而非塑膠袋保存，避免出水變軟。

en.name: Corn
en.desc: Sweet yellow kernels on the cob. Boil, grill or steam; cut the kernels for soups, stir-fries and fried rice.
en.tip: Keep in the husk and refrigerate; the sugars turn starchy fast, so eat within a day or two.

zh.name: 玉米
zh.desc: 金黃香甜的玉米，連軸水煮、燒烤或蒸；剝粒則可入湯、快炒或炒飯。
zh.tip: 帶葉冷藏；甜分很快轉為澱粉，宜一兩日內食用。

en.name: Baby corn
en.desc: Tiny immature cobs eaten whole — tender, mildly sweet and fully edible. For stir-fries, hot pot and blanched salads.
en.tip: Refrigerate in a bag; eat within a few days while crisp.

zh.name: 玉米筍
zh.desc: 幼嫩的小玉米，整支可食、清甜爽脆。快炒、火鍋或汆燙涼拌皆宜。
zh.tip: 裝袋冷藏，趁脆數日內食用。
